title: GSST: Parallel string decompression at 191 GB/s on GPU
key_contribution: Demonstrated fused decompression + processing at 191 GB/s, proving that fusing decode with downstream operations can achieve near-memory-bandwidth throughput.

title: Boosting data filtering on columnar encoding with SIMD
key_contribution: SBoost system fuses filtering with decode on encoded columnar data, achieving 18 billion numbers/second — direct precedent for fusing decode with downstream computation.

title: Exploring SIMD Vectorization in Aggregation Pipelines for Encoded IoT Data
key_contribution: Showed that aggregation can be computed directly on encoded data without full decoding, using SIMD to fuse decode+aggregate in a single pipeline.
